content.text: Open Face Chinese Poker is a partition game where players receive 13 cards over several rounds and place them face-up into three hands: Back (5), Middle (5), and Front (3). Hands must be in descending strength (Back â‰¥ Middle â‰¥ Front) or the player fouls. Players score by winning hand comparisons and earning royalties for premium hands. Fantasyland rewards QQ+ in Front with 13 cards dealt at once next hand.
OFCP originated in Russia and Finland in the early 21st century. It was introduced to the poker circuit by Russian players in Paris in early 2012.
Standard 52-card deck. Each player has a board with 13 slots (Back 5, Middle 5, Front 3).
Standard deck, chips or score sheet, agreed stake per point.
Dealer gives 5 cards face-down. Players set them face-up. Then each player draws 1 card at a time (8 rounds), placing each in Back, Middle, or Front. Cards cannot be moved once placed.

items.text: Pineapple OFCP: 3 cards per turn; set 2, discard 1 face-down. Faster and more strategic. Popular with 3 players.
Progressive OFCP: Fantasyland hand size depends on Top pair: KK=15 cards, AA=16, Trips=17. Discard excess before setting.
Pineapple 2-7 OFCP: Middle hand is low-ball (2-7 ranking). Front and Back are high. 75432 in middle earns royalties.
